snippet.title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis [Official Teaser]
snippet.description:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is coming. Travel back to the early days of the Kingdom, rewrite history, and change Linirea’s fate forever! Wishlist on Steam to stay up to date and support the journey: https://link.ironhidegames.com/teaser?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video

Coming back to Linirea’s origins reminds us why so many of you fell in love with this world and its characters in the first place. Over the years, this saga has grown into something much bigger than we ever imagined, and that makes coming back to it even more special. The chance to create another chapter in a world that means so much to so many people is really special to us. 

We’re excited to share this journey with you and can’t wait for you to feel that magic again. 
Are you ready to return to Genesis?
https://www.kingdomrushgenesis.com/
